newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin returns status to securities commission.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin returns status to securities commission.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has restored Russia's main securities watchdog, the Federal Commission on the Securities Market, to its former status, Prime news agency said on Monday.

In August a presidential decree downgraded the Commission, whose chairman had held ministerial rank and reported to Yeltsin, to a Committee, and Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said it would report to the finance ministry.
But supporting documents to confirm the change were never issued.
The original move led share market participants to fear the commission could lose its independence and powers to regulate the market.
